create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow graph using Graph() to model computation with nodes and edges
add_node_to_graph: add a named node to the graph using graph.add_node with name and op_type
add_edge_between_nodes: add an edge between source and sink nodes using graph.add_edge with size
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize the graph by converting MultiSourceEdges to regular Edges using graph.canonicalize
build_multi_fanin_graph: build a multi-fan-in graph where nodes B and C both feed into node D
